identity.label: Mouse preimplantation development, zygote to morula
identity.what_it_is: a reference trajectory assembled from published stage structure, to exercise the format against a real developmental series rather than an invented one

reference.note: wild type. This trajectory carries no edits - it is the baseline a design would be compared against.

provenance.note: spheres of conserved total volume in a fixed shell. A drawing, not a measurement: real blastomeres are flattened against their neighbours and compaction changes shape without changing volume.

geometry.note: exposed surface area not established; it is the geometric quantity UTMM finds lineage bias tracks, and it cannot be derived from a sphere packing

cell_count.source: standard mouse preimplantation timing; cleavage stages by embryonic day, E0.5 = plug morning
cell_count.scope: mouse preimplantation embryo at this stage
cell_count.note: the cleavage series is not in dispute

total_volume_conserved.note: the zona pellucida holds volume roughly constant through cleavage. Assumed here so the drawing is consistent; not measured on any embryo.

cytoplasmic_stiffness_Pa.why: UTMM reports a gradual softening from the 2-cell through morula stages, and the direction is citable; no modulus in pascals is available to us
cytoplasmic_stiffness_Pa.searched: Habibi E, Sinha A, Yang H, et al. Unified Transcriptome and Mechanics Map of the Intact Mammalian Preimplantation Embryo In Situ. bioRxiv 2026. doi:10.64898/2026.02.23.706394 (PMID 42124641)
cytoplasmic_stiffness_Pa.what_would_resolve_it: the UTMM data, or the figure values. It is in-house work, so asking is cheap
cytoplasmic_stiffness_Pa.scope: cytoplasm of a blastomere at this stage

not_established.what: which stages were observed and which were filled in
not_established.answer: NONE were observed by us. Every stage is assembled from published structure, and observed:false is set on all of them.

not_established.what: for each channel, on how many cells it was actually measured
not_established.answer: zero. geometry is depicted on every cell; mechanics and transcriptome are absent per cell and present only as a per-stage ordinal.

not_established.what: whether the geometry is a measurement, a reconstruction, or a drawing
not_established.answer: a drawing. Spheres of conserved total volume in a fixed shell.

not_established.what: what the file cannot be used to simulate
not_established.answer: anything mechanical. There is no modulus, no adhesion, no cortical tension and no zona. It can be rendered and it can be compared stage-for-stage on cell count; it cannot be used to predict a fate decision.

not_established.what: exposed surface area, the quantity lineage bias tracks
not_established.answer: not established, and not derivable from this packing.
absent. UTMM measures it per cell in situ; we have the paper, not the data.
